label: digit 3 input late in the original phase, in sequences starting with s/u
explanation: Very sparse feature (about 0.01% of steps). It fires only in the original phase at steps 5-8, near the end of the original sequence (to_go 0-2), plus weakly on <DEL> (5% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase. The input digit 3 carries 71% of activation mass (20x lift), but only about 1% of late-position 3s activate it, so most of the gating comes from earlier context. Activation is much more likely and much stronger when the sequence starts with s or u (first_tok s 13x, u 7x) and has i/u in the first few positions (e.g. s u i ..., u u i ...), and when the original contains more digits. The top activations (max 3.8) are all a 3 at step 6-7 after prefixes like s u i. Weak activations also land on letters right after a digit (prev_tok 1 has 10x lift). Restricting to first_tok in {s,u} raises precision to about 11% but cuts mass recall to about 47%. The best predicate tried had dev F1 of about 0.22, so the exact context conjunction is not captured.
